description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MinDaysBetweenDisbursalAndFirstRepaymentViolationException' used within the loan account module of Fineract to handle violations related to minimum days between disbursal and first repayment.

classes.name: MinDaysBetweenDisbursalAndFirstRepaymentViolationException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the number of days between the loan disbursal date and the first repayment date is less than the allowed minimum.

methods.name: MinDaysBetweenDisbursalAndFirstRepaymentViolationException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with relevant details about the disbursal date, first repayment date, and the minimum allowed days between them.
